standard.coverage: Employers with 2 or more employees aged 16 and older.
standard.note: The schedule set after the Michigan Supreme Court's 2024 Mothering Justice decision and the February 2025 amendments: $12.48 (2025-02-21), $13.73 (2026-01-01), $15.00 (2027-01-01), then annual inflation adjustment from 2028. 2027: $15.00 (see provisional.updatedFor2027).

tipped.note: Michigan's tipped percentage RISES each year under the 2025 amendments: 40% of the minimum wage in 2026 ($5.49), 42% in 2027, stepping to 50% by 2031. A payroll system that hardcodes a percentage rather than reading the year's figure will drift.

variants.label: Employees aged 16 and 17
variants.test: 85% of the state minimum wage -- 85% of $15.00 = $12.75.

youthAndTraining.label: Training wage
youthAndTraining.eligibility: Employees aged 16-19, first 90 calendar days -- Michigan's own training wage, set at the same $4.25 figure as the federal youth wage.
